source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            components.append(cells)
    comps = sorted(components, key=len, reverse=True)[:2]
    boxes = []
    for cells in comps:
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
        boxes.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    boxes.sort(key=lambda b: b[2])
    (ar0,ar1,ac0,ac1),(br0,br1,bc0,bc1)=boxes
    height=min(ar1-ar0+1,br1-br0+1)
    width=min(ac1-ac0+1,bc1-bc0+1)
    diffs=[]
    for y in range(height):
        row=[8 if grid[ar0+y][ac0+x] != grid[br0+y][bc0+x] else 0 for x in range(width)]
        diffs.append(row)
    active=[i for i,row in enumerate(diffs) if any(row)]
    if not active:
        return [[0]]
    return diffs[min(active):max(active)+1]
'''
